author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs a creator-controlled equal-slice wheel with natural OBS animation, bounded multi-platform winner messages, and a result card.
changelog: 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: initial release with two-to-ten equal choices, server-authoritative selection, studded wheel animation, moderator command control, platform-bounded winner messages, and cropped browser-source support.

manifest.name: Prize Wheel
installationSteps: Add the hosted Prize Wheel browser source to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs.
Create a no-response spinwheel command in Command Sync and restrict it to moderators or the broadcaster.
Enter two through ten unique wheel choices, choose chat destinations, save, enable, and send a preview.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling preserves only the last bounded spin timestamp and winning choice.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded choices, serialized spins, delayed announcements, and the hosted wheel renderer.
